newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending last two-session gain.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending last two-session gain.

text.p: Polish shares were seen rising for the third consecutive session after most stocks rose in the Wednesday post-regular session continuous trade system.
Analysts said that in the lack of strong fundamental signals Polish speculators were watching Wall Street movements for clues and Dow Jones Wednesday's gain might also help the Warsaw bourse rise.

Debt-ridden construction firm Espebepe was expected to extend its last two sessions' 20 percent surge on rising hopes that a new restructuring programme would be accepted by its creditors. -- Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
